address: 1844/1 Mittraphap Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima, Nakhon Ratchasima, 30000, Thailand
bio: It’s hard to miss this restaurant with its large orange crab statue out front. And you wouldn’t want to miss eating here either. Inside is a mix of industrial and rustic décor, with a stage for live music. A small English-style garden with a water fountain surrounded by trees provides tranquil outdoor dining. The fresh catch of shrimp, prawns and crabs are as fresh as can be, swimming in their tanks up until an order comes in. The signature baked glass noodles with hot pot crab is superb in a herby gravy; the grilled tiger prawns and Thai spicy seafood sauce is also delightful....
